title: Glitch Tokens taxonomy
model: seven LLMs evaluated in the paper

cells.title: Source
body: "Glitch Tokens in Large Language Models: Categorization Taxonomy and Effective Detection" was submitted to arXiv on April 15, 2024.
The paper studied anomalous tokens produced by established tokenizers and categorized symptoms shown by LLMs when interacting with them.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The paper described glitch tokens as tokens that could compromise response quality when included in prompts.
The authors evaluated seven popular LLMs, three tokenizers, and 182,517 tokens.

cells.title: Provenance
body: This file uses the paper as a source-stable anchor for the glitch-token category rather than relying on scattered screenshots.
